headline: A 2005 executive order carries out changes to an agreement about the U.S. border, though few details are available.
what_it_does: This order puts into effect amendments, or changes, to an existing agreement dealing with the border. The title does not say which border or what the changes are. No summary was provided, so the specific effects cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work under the border agreement
who_it_affects.how: They would follow the amended terms of the agreement as directed by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 17, 2005; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
